a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and

partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's

environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and

employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process

jobs.occupation: Head of Academies (m/f/d) (Rektor/in / Präsident/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking an
experienced Head of Academies (m/f/d) to provide operational
leadership for the European Raw Materials Academy and the European
Advanced Materials Academy. The European Raw Materials Academy and the
European Advanced Materials Academy are flagship European initiatives
that develop the skills and talent needed to strengthen Europe’s
competitiveness and industrial transformation in the raw and advanced
materials sectors. Reporting to the Director of Education & Skills,
the Head of Academies is responsible for translating strategic
priorities into operational delivery and ensuring the successful
implementation, scaling, and continuous improvement of both Academies.
The Head of Academies (m/f/d) provides direct line management to three
Senior Education Managers who collectively lead a multidisciplinary
team of approximately 20 colleagues. The ideal candidate combines
operational excellence with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven
ability to scale digital education initiatives. Success will be
measured through learner growth, program quality, operational
performance, and delivery against agreed Academy KPIs. Key
Accountabilities The Head of Academies is accountable for: 1.
Operational Delivery • Translate strategic priorities into
operational plans and ensure successful delivery against agreed
objectives, KPIs, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and
compliance requirements. • Establish and maintain effective
operational processes, governance, reporting, and continuous
improvement across both Academies. 2. Education Portfolio & Digital
Learning Platforms • Lead the operational management and continuous
improvement of the Academies' digital learning ecosystem, providing
recommendations to support strategic decision-making. • Drive
learner growth, program quality, and an excellent learner experience
through effective operational management and data-informed
decision-making. 3. Team Leadership • Lead, coach, and support the
Senior Managers responsible for Operations, Course Development, and
Partnerships. • Foster a high-performing, collaborative, and
accountable multidisciplinary team. 4. Operational Performance &
Resources • Manage operational budgets within agreed frameworks,
supplier relationships, and procurement activities to support the
successful delivery of both Academies and ensure efficient and
compliant use of resources. • Develop, monitor, and report on
Academy KPIs, analyse operational performance, identify risks and
opportunities, and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. 5.
Stakeholder Collaboration • Maintain productive relationships with
internal teams and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment,
successful delivery, and sustainable growth of both Academies. What
We’re Looking For Required • Experience leading professional
learning, education, or workforce development programs. • Proven
success scaling digital education, EdTech, or professional learning
initiatives. • Operational leadership and program management
experience, including digital learning platforms and Learning
Management Systems. • Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary
teams and delivering against ambitious KPIs and operational
objectives. • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder
management skills. • Excellent written and spoken English. Desirable
• Background in EdTech, professional education, or corporate
learning and development. • Experience building or scaling education
academies, digital learning platforms, or comparable education
initiatives. • Familiarity with EU-funded projects, Horizon Europe,
Erasmus+, or the EIT ecosystem. • Understanding of quality
assurance, certification, credentials, and micro-credentials. •
Working knowledge of additional European languages. What We Offer •
The opportunity to lead the operational scaling of two flagship
European Academies with significant strategic impact. • Join a
committed, mission-driven team working at the intersection of
education, innovation, industry, and European policy. • Work with
leading European universities, industry partners, and public-sector
organisations to help shape the future workforce for the raw and
advanced materials sectors. • Hybrid working environment in Berlin.
• Competitive salary. Position Details • Location: Berlin,
Germany. • Contract: Full-time. • Duration: Fixed-term contract
until 2029, with the possibility of extension. • Travel: Occasional
travel within Europe is required. • Reports to: Director of
Education & Skills, EIT RawMaterials. Commitment to Diversity: EIT
RawMaterials is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage
applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of background.

jobs.occupation: Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware Production (Qualitätsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES THE WHY At Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder. THE WHAT
• Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance
• Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness
• Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor
• Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability
• Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: Playfulness

YOUR PROFILE
• 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office
• Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management
• Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end
• Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy
• Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity
• Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator
• Fluent English is a must; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER
• Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.
• Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.
• Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.
• Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.
• Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.
• Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.
• Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.

About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

jobs.occupation: Quality Engineer (m/w/d) Aerospace (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES The What: At Blackwave GmbH, we develop and manufacture high-performance carbon fiber components for airplanes, rockets, and satellites — pushing the limits of lightweight design and precision manufacturing. Our mission: To end COPV failure in spaceflight. The benchmark for performance, reliability and cost efficiency.

The Why: Because quality is the foundation of innovation. Every component we deliver must perform flawlessly under extreme conditions — in the air, in orbit, and beyond. As part of our Quality team, you ensure that our processes meet the highest standards, enabling us to turn cutting-edge ideas into flight-ready solutions.

Important Note: This role is focused on Quality Assurance of our hardware (COPVs). We are not currently hiring for Software Quality Assurance positions

• Project & Process Quality Assurance: You define and implement quality assurance strategies across the entire product lifecycle - from suppliers and development to serial production.
• Manufacturing & Process Quality: You accompany production on the shop floor, working closely with manufacturing teams to ensure quality requirements are effectively implemented at all production stations.
• Change Control: You support product and process changes, ensure quality requirements are considered and contribute to approval and implementation activities.
• Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions: You analyze quality deviations using structured methods (e.g. 8D, Ishikawa, 5-Why), derive sustainable corrective actions, and ensure their implementation.
• Continuous Improvement & Audits: You monitor key quality indicators (e.g. audit findings, non-conformities) and proactively drive continuous improvement of processes and standards.

YOUR PROFILE
• Training & studies - You have completed degree in engineering, quality management, production technology, or a comparable qualification
• Professional experience - You have relevant experience in quality planning and risk management, ideally in a manufacturing environment
• Analytical Thinking & Root Cause Analysis: You are skilled at identifying patterns, isolating root causes (e.g. using 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa), and translating findings into actionable improvements
• Standards & Compliance Knowledge: You are familiar with applicable quality standards and their practical implementation, as well as experience with ISO9001
• Working Style & Mindset: You work independently, think in solutions, and enjoy deriving insights from quality data. You pursue excellence and value precision and reliability
• Language skills - Very good written and spoken English, German is also nice to have for collaboration between departments

WHAT WE OFFER
• Personal responsibility & creative freedom: You actively contribute to the further development of our production technologies.
• Flexible working hours & mobile working: Work-life balance is not an empty promise with us.
• Start-up spirit meets aerospace: flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes and room for innovation.
• Individual benefits: Choose between a Germany ticket, Egym-Wellpass or a tax-free benefit in kind with the Give Card.
• Fresh food every day: Shared lunch break with healthy, varied dishes.
• Alpine view included: Our roof terrace invites you to relax after work.
• Further development guaranteed: You will grow both professionally and personally through exciting projects and exchanges with experts.
• We live and breathe team culture: whether it's a tech talk, team event or after-work - we celebrate successes together.

jobs.occupation: Offshore LTP Project Manager (f/m/d) – Gas Turbine Projects (Ingenieur/in - Energietechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Offshore LTP Project Manager in SE GS AP PM C3, you play a key role in delivering Gas Turbine Long-Term Program projects and in building long-term customer success in Korea, Japan, and Australia.

You drive project execution from a technical, commercial, and operational perspective and work closely with your onshore Project Management partners to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards. In doing so, you act as a key interface between the customer and internal stakeholders and help turn project challenges into practical solutions.

In your daily work, you collaborate across functions including Engineering, Field Service, Procurement, Finance, Sales, and Onshore Project Management. Your ability to stay structured, build trust, and keep execution on track contributes directly to customer satisfaction and business success.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Project Ownership:Take full responsibility for the execution of assigned Gas Turbine LTP projects across the Asia Pacific region.
* Customer Success:Build strong customer relationships through reliable execution, transparent communication, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
* Execution Excellence:Ensure delivery in line with project scope, schedule, cost, quality, and contractual requirements.
* Commercial Performance:Actively manage project cost, invoicing, cash flow, risks and opportunities, claims, and change order potential in close cooperation with Commercial Project Manager.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with Onshore Project Management, Engineering, Field Service, Procurement, Finance, and Sales to achieve project and business targets.
* Problem Solving:Identify risks and issues early, drive mitigation actions, and support timely resolution of technical, operational, and commercial topics.
* Continuous Improvement:Apply project management standards and tools with discipline and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and ways of working.

What You Bring

* BS in Engineering or related field of study
* Significant professional experience in project management, ideally in Gas Turbine service business and/or Long-Term Program execution
* Strong technical and commercial understanding of project execution in the power generation industry
* Experience managing customer interfaces and coordinating cross-functional teams in an international business environment
* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage technical, operational, commercial, and customer-related topics in a structured and professional manner
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic environment
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required
* Business proficiency in both German and English
* Project Management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI or comparable) is considered an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

jobs.occupation: Security Compliance Lead (JCP) (m/f/d) (Cyber-Security-Consultant)
jobs.description:
What you’ll do 

As JetBrains expands its cloud and SaaS offerings, maintaining customer trust and robust security compliance is critical. We are investing in the security posture and compliance program for JetBrains Cloud Platform (JCP), a new JetBrains offering, moving beyond checklist-driven security to build practical, real-world controls.

In this role, you will take ownership of our compliance program from design to execution, focusing on SOC 2 and ISO standards. You’ll sit at the intersection of product security, platform engineering, legal, and customer-facing teams. Rather than imposing rigid bureaucracy, you’ll help design workflows that protect user data while keeping development teams fast and autonomous. You’ll also serve as a key technical voice on compliance matters, speaking directly with customers to explain our security architecture and build trust.

Day to day, you will:

- Design, implement, and mature the compliance program for JCP, focusing initially on SOC 2 (Type 1 and Type 2) and ISO standards (such as ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, and 42001).
- Translate complex framework requirements into clear, practical controls that fit how JetBrains builds products.
- Partner with product security, platform engineering, legal, and people teams to embed security and compliance requirements into day-to-day work (policies, procedures, onboarding, training, SDLC, vendor management, etc.).
- Coordinate evidence collection, control testing, and remediation for internal reviews and external audits.
- Maintain and improve core compliance documentation, including policies, standards, control catalogs, risk registers, and playbooks.
- Respond to customer security questionnaires, participate in due diligence calls, and collaborate with account teams to handle non-standard compliance requests.
- Monitor changes in relevant standards and regulations and help keep our program aligned with them.

What you’ll bring

- A practical mindset that values clear systems and real outcomes over rigid checklists.
- A clear, structured communication style that makes technical security concepts accessible to any audience.
- A detail-oriented approach with the curiosity to navigate both policy text and technical architecture.
- Calmness and confidence when guiding customers through security due diligence.

What you’ll need

- Established hands-on experience building and maturing compliance programs around SOC 2 and ISO security standards.
- Experience managing security compliance in SaaS or cloud environments (such as AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Practical experience across core security and compliance domains, including access management, logging, secure development, vendor risk, and business continuity.
- A track record of collaborating effectively with technical teams (engineering, SRE, product security, etc.) and turning framework language into concrete, realistic requirements.
- Direct experience answering customer security questionnaires and leading customer-facing compliance discussions.
- Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It would be great if you also have:

- Experience with other frameworks and regulations relevant to SaaS, such as FedRAMP, ISMAP, or others.
- Experience working inside or closely with product security, cloud security, or risk management teams.
- Familiarity with security and compliance tooling (such as GRC platforms, ticketing systems, policy and evidence repositories, asset and identity management tools).
- Prior experience in a fast-growing or multi-product environment where processes and ownership boundaries are evolving.

What success looks like 

Success in this role means establishing a clear, reliable compliance foundation for JetBrains Cloud Platform that strengthens customer trust and respects engineering autonomy. You’ll know you’re succeeding when compliance controls feel like a natural part of product development, external audits run smoothly without last-minute scrambles, and customer security calls build lasting confidence in our platform.

**Why join JetBrains?** 

- Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer – Research Algorithm/Model Expert (Scientific Brain Domain) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
About the Company

CHN Energy Europe Research GmbH (CHEER) is a subsidiary of CHN Energy Investment Group (China Energy) based in Berlin, Germany. Being an integral part of China Energy’s globalized research and development layout, CHEER features in integrated European-Chinese innovation culture and advanced technology, and operates business in new energy technology research and development with purposes of promoting and accelerating carbon neutrality and making its own contribution in alleviating global climate change.

Its parent company, China Energy, operates eight business segments including coal, thermal power, new energy, hydro-power, transportation, coal-to-chemicals, environmental technology and finance. Those businesses distribute in more than 10 countries and regions, including China, Europe, the United States, Canada and Australia. It is the world’s largest producer of coal, thermal power, wind power, as well as coal-to-chemicals. It is ranked 92nd in the Fortune Global 500 in 2025.

Centered on the green development strategy and the strategy of innovation-driven scientific and technological development, CHEER is committed to building a world-class research institute with global competitiveness. We focus on six key R&D areas: diversified power conversion, advanced chemical engineering, hydrogen energy, artificial intelligence, energy storage, and new environmental protection technologies.

We are building teams to develop cutting-edge sustainable and affordable technologies to improve energy efficiency, protect the environment, and mitigate climate change. Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, skill, imagination, passion, and teamwork of people like you. Currently we have openings for leading experts with a range of focus areas including energy, chemistry, and artificial intelligence. We offer competitive compensation packages and excellent benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Develop AI algorithms and technologies to optimize predictive models and improve materials development strategies, thereby accelerating the discovery and optimization of catalysts.
2. Apply robotics-based high-throughput experimentation to rapidly synthesize and test a vast array of catalyst candidates, expediting the identification of highly efficient catalysts.
3. Use AI algorithms to analyze chemical data, predict the properties of potential catalysts, and support the design of new catalysts with improved activity and selectivity.
4. Employ AI-based computational modeling techniques to predict catalyst behavior at the atomic level, simulate reactant adsorption, activation, and reaction pathways, identify promising catalyst candidates, and guide experimental work toward the most effective design directions.

Qualification Requirements:

1. Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field (e.g., Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering).
2. Professional experience in AI algorithms or related research/industry projects.
3. Deep understanding of Transformer architectures and their variants; familiarity with large models such as BERT, GPT, and LLaMA.
4. Experience with distributed training, model parallelism, and model compression.
5. Proven experience in large model development and optimization; proficient with frameworks such as ChatGPT, DeepSpeed, Megatron; knowledge of RLHF and PEFT.
6. Strong research track record with publications in top international conferences/journals, or highly cited research outputs/patents.
7. Excellent project management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams.
8. Very good English skills are required; German and/or Chinese is an advantage.

Join us and become a leader in driving clean energy innovation, together shaping the brilliant future of the new energy sector!

We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer an attractive compensation package based on the responsibilities of the role, the candidate’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and overall fit. Additional benefits and supplementary payments may be granted in accordance with company policies and individual eligibility.
- Excellent research environment**:** Sufficient research funding and access to advanced digital tools and innovative technologies.
- Innovative workplace: Exciting and diverse tasks in an international R&D setting with a collaborative, open atmosphere.
- Room for creativity: Freedom to contribute your own ideas and actively shape forward-looking solutions in sustainable energy, technology, and organizational development.
- International collaboration: Interdisciplinary projects and partnerships with renowned academic and industry players across Europe, including opportunities for international exchange.
- Career development: Tailored training programs, individual career pathways, and support for participation in professional events and confe

Application process:

Please send your application documents by email to

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

Subject line: “[Position] – [Your Name]”.

Your application should include:

- CV (including information/listing of representative research projects for R&D positions)
- University certificates / transcripts (if available)
- Reference letters from previous employers (if available)

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your data for the purpose of the recruitment process.

All documents will be treated confidentially in accordance with GDPR. We retain applications for up to six months after completion of the recruitment process, unless you give explicit consent for longer storage.

For questions regarding the position or the application process, please contact our Recruiting Team:

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com
